dispositions.topic_text: Retry, interruption, cancellation, and failure rules for lock acquisition
dispositions.what: Which errors of opening or locking the lock file are refused and how an interrupted wait is handled.

dispositions.topic_text: Validation and classification of structurally or semantically invalid state records
dispositions.what: The full validation of a stored record: value types, enumeration values, nested models and extra fields.

dispositions.topic_text: Classification of absent, inaccessible, or concurrently removed state files
dispositions.what: How nonexistence of a record is determined, including a dangling link.

dispositions.topic_text: Persistent-state assertions required to prove no unintended placements or marks
dispositions.what: The witness of INV-20 inspects all placement, mark and image state after each refusal.

dispositions.topic_text: Required damaged-record test matrix across damage classes, record types, and operations
dispositions.what: The witness of INV-20 covers every damage class for both record kinds across scan, delivery and mark.

dispositions.topic_text: Whether a missing project lock file is created or treated as a failure
dispositions.what: The project lock file is created on first use.
